notes: Instructions are small unlabelled pictures; piece identification is by shape/colour matched to the inventory images and counts, so some assignments are best guesses.

Twelve parts (4587002, 4558959, 4295174, 6028813, 4218581, 4621917, 4211065, 4220539, 6027686, 4517925, 6060734, 4515373) were not in the catalogue and are added as new types with plausible ports. Multi-stud pieces got enough distinct stud ports so each stud is used once.

Body is built flipped: round plate b1 with plate b2 on one side and the round brick b9 on the other; the clip plates, hip sockets and arm mounts sit on distinct studs of b2 (view is flipped at step 8).

The arm hinge fingers (4521187) mate with the hinge-like jaw of the black clip plates b7/b8 on the body; modelled as hinge/hinge, so the 4517925 type has both a clip.1 and hinge.1 port for the same jaw. Horns b11/b12 clip onto b3/b4 (clip/bar).
The two arms (page 5) are one repeat. Legs (pages 6-13) differ in slope placement and orange slope count, so they are listed explicitly: left leg b17-b29, right leg b30-b44.
Distribution of the three light-grey 4521921 slopes and three orange 4587002 slopes among the legs follows the inventory counts; exact placement is a guess.
Hip connection: each lower-leg 6039482 ball snaps into a body hip socket (6043639); its socket takes the ball of the foot plate 6039479.
